title: Upgrade @objectstack kernel to v0.9.0
body:
Upgrades @objectstack dependencies from 0.8.2 to 0.9.0 and adds support for the new QA (Quality Assurance) namespace introduced in the protocol.

## Changes

- **Dependency Updates**: Bumped 8 @objectstack packages to 0.9.0 across root and all workspace packages
  - `@objectstack/{cli,core,driver-memory,objectql,plugin-msw,plugin-hono-server,runtime,spec,client}`

- **Protocol Compliance**: Added QA namespace to type re-exports in `packages/types/src/index.ts`

```typescript
// Before
export type { Data, UI, System, AI, API, Auth, Hub, Automation, Permission, Shared } from '@objectstack/spec';

// After
export type { Data, UI, System, AI, API, Auth, Hub, Automation, Permission, Shared, QA } from '@objectstack/spec';
```

This maintains backward compatibility while exposing the new QA protocol capabilities to ObjectUI consumers.
